name: Bellator Shirt and Waistcoat Continental
description:
Stylish, functional, and deadly: the Bellator clothing line is designed to fit in at dinner party just as well as a gunfight. Accompanied by a luxurious silk tie and smart fitting waistcoat, this shirts provides some combat protection thanks to the intricate weaving of layered graphene into its threads.

The Continental edition features a gray waistcoat, off-white shirt, and a teal tie with star-like patterns.
